headline: Majkel1337 climbs to seventh on ARC-2

sections.text: Majkel1337 gained 6.11 points to reach 68.19, moving from 10th to 7th on the ARC-2 board.
The jump puts the team among the seven highest-scoring entries, with the gold line currently at 54.17.
